scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@mp/api
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@mp/app
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run web --workspace=@mp/app
scripts.db:apply: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; atlas schema apply --env app'
scripts.db:plan: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; atlas schema apply --env app --dry-run'
scripts.db:inspect: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; atlas schema inspect --env app --format "{{ sql . }}"'
